title: Pullback naturality of the termwise hypercohomology spectral sequence
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $K^\bullet$ and $L^\bullet$ be bounded-below complexes of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on $X$ and $Y$, and let $u:f^{-1}K^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ be a morphism of complexes [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For the hypercohomology spectral sequences [thm-sp-if-e1] of the global-sections functors on $X$ and $Y$, indexed as $E_1^{p,q}(X,K)=H^p(X_{\Et},K^q)$ and $E_1^{p,q}(Y,L)=H^p(Y_{\Et},L^q)$ with $q$ the filtration degree, the pair $(f,u)$ induces a morphism of spectral sequences [def-sp-spectral-sequence]. Its $E_1^{p,q}$ map is $H^p(X_{\Et},K^q)\xrightarrow{f^*}H^p(Y_{\Et},f^{-1}K^q)\xrightarrow{H^p(u^q)}H^p(Y_{\Et},L^q)$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Its abutment map is the canonical map $H^n(X_{\Et},K^\bullet)\to H^n(Y_{\Et},L^\bullet)$ on derived global sections [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], and it preserves the finite decreasing filtrations by $q$ and commutes with the identifications $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^qH^{p+q}$ of [thm-sp-if-e1]. These spectral-sequence and abutment maps are identity maps when $(f,u)$ is the identity, and compose for successive pairs $(f,u)$ after the canonical identification of composite inverse images [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition].
